blurb: Angry Inch Brewing offers a taproom atmosphere that feels like home, with a focus on Belgian-inspired brews and a rotating tap list including craft soda, seltzer, beer, and cold press coffee. Guests can enjoy food trucks, pop-ups, and events at the taproom. The taproom is located in downtown Lakeville and is open Wednesday through Sunday with varying hours.
extraNote: No outside alcohol except sealed 0% non-alcoholic beverages · Minimum purchase required for taproom rental; gift cards and growlerships do not count · Taxes and minimum 20% gratuity added to all tabs · Taproom rental time frame must be within 11am to 11pm and include setup and cleanup · No pets inside taproom; pets allowed on patio if leashed and owner attends · Parking available on street and shared lot behind building; follow posted signs · Taproom at 20841 Holyoke Avenue, Lakeville, MN 55044
